item.title: Foundation Christian Academy Falcons fly to new district
item.description: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – Earlier this year, Foundation Christian Academy announced that the school is moving from the 14th District to the 13th District beginning next school year. News 40’s Samantha Money has more on how the shift will open many doors of opportunity for the Falcons, especially for basketball.
